title: P15 E3: the A28' fixture-hash helper was defined in a suite block that P11_ONLY runs skip, so NC1 failed in both arms
what_went_wrong: The E3 patch anchored on the first CHECKSUM line in the suite, which belongs to the P10 stage_cks (inside the main-suite block guarded by -z P11_ONLY), not to stage_cks_p11.
hash_p11 was therefore undefined in the P11_ONLY=28 runs; the fixture hash was empty, the A28' check failed WITH and WITHOUT the switch: NC 1 NOT-DISCRIMINATING (p15_chain NC 4/5).
The intended NULL guard landed on the P10 stage_cks instead of stage_cks_p11 (harmless there; full suite 39/39).
root_cause: Patch anchored on text, not on the function name; no dev run of P11_ONLY=28 before freezing.
detection: P15 chain step 5d (NC 1: with-switch=FAIL without=FAIL); suite evidence shows 'fixture hash before/after:  / '.
impact: No false claim: the runner reported NOT-DISCRIMINATING and the chain exit nc=1.

correction.applied: hash_p11 moved into the P11 block, NULL guard added to stage_cks_p11; suite unfrozen/re-frozen (manifest 20261026b); E steps re-run by p15_chain_e.sh.

rule: Before freezing, run every selective path (P11_ONLY=<id>) once, not only the full suite.
